instagram.content:
Brothers and sisters, the enemy whispers that your worth is measured by circumstance. But God declares in Psalm 139:14, “You are fearfully and wonderfully made.” Stand firm in that truth—your identity is anchored in the Creator, not the moment.

Declare today: I am a child of the King, unshakable.

What has God revealed to you about your true worth?
